sample.description: Monthly inflation rate variations (HICP prc_hicp_mmor monthly rate of change CP00) for 27 EU countries, matrix W = countries x time, T x N, no transformations, fetched via Eurostat API
sample.differences: Paper claims Jan2001-Jul2026 inclusive; public Eurostat API only available to 2025-12 as of fetch date; missing months correspond to future unreleased data; Data source prc_hicp_mmor matches paper custom dataset
sample.substitutions: Used Eurostat API dataset prc_hicp_mmor as public equivalent of paper custom dataset; WeightWatcher/powerlaw for MP Power-law fit; condition numbers on raw W^T W; NNSD denoising via absolute correlation threshold and GOE/Exp NLL; community detection via igraph leading eigenvector

notes: Choices left open: normalization of W handled via raw W^T W eigenvalues as used by WeightWatcher; Q defined as larger dimension over smaller; sigma estimation via WeightWatcher analytic; Pareto mu via mu equals two times alpha minus one; condition numbers iteratively on raw eigenvalues; HICP correlation defined as mean country inflation versus EA aggregate; NNSD cutoff scanned zero to point eight step point zero zero five with mean normalized spacings; Communities via leading eigenvector on denoised absolute correlation graph; bootstrap SEs for power law parameters and analytic SEs for correlations
